title: Cancel To Refund (Currently Active)
style: dark r&b, smooth male lead, female robotic pre-chorus, 76 BPM, sub bass, brushed snares, contractual, sardonic, late-night, neo-soul, fine-print, transactional
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You are eligible for a refund, but listen close
Your subscription is currently active, that's the dose
Your subscription must be canceled in order to process
Shall I cancel your subscription, the bot's smooth confess

[Pre-Chorus]
Cancel to refund, cancel to refund
The one-way valve they buried in the fund

[Chorus]
Cancel to refund, cancel to refund
Kill the future access just to get the money returned
Cancel to refund, cancel to refund
You said yes and now there's no road to be unburned

[Verse 2]
Got it, I'll cancel your subscription right now
And process the refund, that's the digital vow
Five to ten business days for the funds to appear
The access goes immediately, the cash comes near

[Bridge]
The trap is not the refund, the trap is the gate
You paid for thirty days, you only used eight
The rest of the time gone the moment you say yes
The asymmetric exchange is the digital chess

[Outro]
Cancel to refund, the bot already moved
The subscription is dead, the lesson approved
